baseline: 7880efd E14 runtime, E13 fact recovery=1 and E14 lazy retrieval=1
archive_audit: Zero new inference. E14 original90:6/10 minima during reranker construction and4/10 after answer_model_start; constructor minima may remain unaffected by the candidate. Matched controls use same sampled residency and nearest starting availability, with distance disclosed.
candidate: Only FOOTBALL_RELEASE_RERANKER=1: after retrieval/packing completes and before answer inference, drop the reranker owner and run Python collection. Preserve ranked candidate packet, evidence content, order, Prompt, Schema, source and output checks. Default off. Reconstruct same pinned reranker if an engine instance receives another normal question.
measurement: Stdlib stage markers plus external actual per-PID RSS/private/native peaks with creation-time-aware roles. Target200ms wait, report actual intervals; approximately1s Ollama residency snapshots. Explicit object_collected event is not evidence of OS memory recovery. Show before/after release deltas and whole-request minima including construction.
special: Real browser normal frontend/default Worker, E13 and E14 enabled in both. InterleavedAB/BA, representative D001,D003,D023,T013,T026 repeated twice, additional D002,T001,D004 and D036 pervariant.14 paired cases=28 requests. First frontend normal question is cold. Each candidate order and actual Prompt compared bytewise within pair; source judgments and actual final output separately audited. Start-availability bounds are reported, never forced by allocating memory or closing user applications.

special_gates.correctness: D001,D002,T001 correct; D003 ordinary refusal retained; T013/T026 point/citation grades at least concurrent control, any model variation reported; D036 zero retrieval and answercalls, no reconstruction
special_gates.inputs: ranked candidate results/order, full actual evidence and Prompt unchanged
special_gates.resource: Every B visible reply<=60s and sampled system available>=1GiB, including pre-release peaks
special_gates.release: Every applicable B release has collected owner, report measured RSS/private/system delta instead of assuming reclamation

stop: No full90 unless special quality/mechanism and entire-request resource gates pass. Emergency available<.35GiB for3samples stops only owned model server. One component behavior per candidate; no extra swapping/order/arena/worker-persistence changes.

full90_if_special_passes.citations: Compare with E14 actual75/123 and same-response pre-fallback72/120, plus historical72/118; independently review new paragraph combinations and per-question regressions

holdout: Only if full90 quality and resource both pass may frozen40 be used for final quality acceptance; never use it to tune. Concurrency and long-run acceptance separate.
